screens.screen: delivery offers (work-status switch, offer pager with accept-order card, 5-tab bottom nav)
order details for the captain (route button, status steps, items, update-status bar)

notes: Same brand colours as the customer app (#f4333f). The theme names 'Cairo' but this repo does not bundle the font (no fonts section in pubspec), so the real app falls back to the system font; drawn with the iOS system Arabic font (SF Arabic). The app has no in-app map: 'عرض المسار على الخريطة' opens Google Maps externally, so no map screen was drawn. The work-status control is Switch.adaptive, drawn as the iOS switch. In order details the code binds all three amount lines to totalAmount (looks like a bug); sample data shows subtotal / delivery fee / total instead. Order shown at status 4 (ready) because the status-5 chat/call cards use a default CircleAvatar whose white icon sits on the theme's light-grey primaryContainer. The bottom update-status bar has no SafeArea in the code, so it sits under the home indicator. Wallet currency code is whatever the API returns; 'YER' is sample data.
